name: repo-publication-readiness
description: Prepare a private GitHub repository for public release: audit every ref with two secret scanners plus the merge-resolution, commit-message and binary-content passes both miss; sweep identities, internal hosts and IPs, and a private deny list of employer and client names; rotate, rewrite with git-filter-repo and prove the rewrite; decide the non-code surfaces; clear licensing and employer IP; harden Actions and branches; publish to a fresh, pre-protected repository and verify it.
